mission: Frozen HTF 2/3/4h MACD exhaustion nested with 15/30/60m price-pivot confirmations; compare true cycle failure exits versus hold
source: Existing public Terminal consumer /api/intraday? sym=SOXX, tf=15m and tf=30m, ext=0
source_basis: ET-market-local display epoch, explicitly convert to aware ET; no BOATS; original API warns PIT/price adjustment/completeness unverified
lower_time_horizon_note: Scaled30/15 MACD/StochRSI approximately preserves lookback wall duration versus 1h fast profile, but the conventional RSI(14) gate remains 14 bars; not full physical equivalence.
higher_extreme: Original research_v2 setup_episodes histogram >= 2x prior trailing RMS with recent Stoch RSI <=20; one opportunity per negative histogram episode; 26 observed RTH hour expiry.
trigger: Original pivot_turn: confirmed low (2 left, 1 right) + RSI<=45 near pivot + improving MACD histogram + Stoch K>=D + RSI rising
risk: Single baseline 1.5% price stop, five basis points modeled cost per side, stop-first same candle; no model-derived position sizing
execution: Entry at next observed 15-minute opening price after completed lower and parent candle. Sell signal acts at next 15-minute opening bar; stop gaps fill next observed open; intrabar stop-first.
evaluation: Same-entry paired returns, hidden/no-fill statuses, non-overlap opportunity accounting, positive winners sacrificed vs losses saved, paired episode matched entry prices, no new model selection as validated
rights: Terminal displayed bars are not validated actual historical quote fills, adjustment provenance is not verified, sources mixed stored/live
